name: Clevo Co.
summary: Clevo Co., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of computers and computer peripherals in Taiwan, China, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. It also engages in the research, development, production, and sale of computer hardware and software. In addition, the company provides after-sales services. Further, it is involved in building property management. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan. Clevo Co. operates as a subsidiary of Taipei Twin Corporation.
